description.subtitle: Adidas children's walk cap from Real Madrid - white
description.tagline: El escudo que inspira a las nuevas generaciones
description.intro: With this adidas child cap from Real Madrid, the youngest ones will be able to demonstrate their passion with a clean and modern look. The club’s coat of arms stands out on the white base, transmitting identity, history and pride.
key_benefits: Aesthetic Madrid: White design with the club's printed shield.
Lightness and comfort: Soft cotton for daily use without discomfort.
Child Versatility: Ideal for any casual or sporting occasion.
Sunscreen: Visor that protects while playing or walking.
Functional design: Comfortable fit designed for active children.

key_benefits: Estética madridista: Diseño blanco con el escudo estampado del club.
Ligereza y comodidad: Algodón suave para uso diario sin molestias.
Versatilidad infantil: Ideal para cualquier ocasión casual o deportiva.
Protección solar: Visera que protege mientras juegan o pasean.
Diseño funcional: Ajuste cómodo pensado para niños activos.
